+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest.config.findpaths import get_common_ancestor
+
+
+def get_report_root(invocation_dir: Path, paths: Iterable[Path]) -> Path:
+    """Find the common directory for reports.
+
+    If no paths exist, return the parent of the invocation directory.
+    """
+    return get_common_ancestor(invocation_dir.parent, paths)
diff --git a/testing/test_report_root.py b/testing/test_report_root.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..ec66e8db6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_report_root.py
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest.report_root import get_report_root
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("paths", [(), ("missing", "missing/test_example.py")])
+def test_falls_back_to_invocation_parent(
+    tmp_path: Path, paths: tuple[str, ...]
+) -> None:
+    invocation_dir = tmp_path / "run"
+    invocation_dir.mkdir()
+
+    assert (
+        get_report_root(invocation_dir, (invocation_dir / path for path in paths))
+        == tmp_path
+    )
+
+
+def test_ancestor_and_descendant(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    descendant = tmp_path / "tests"
+    descendant.mkdir()
+
+    assert get_report_root(tmp_path, [tmp_path, descendant]) == tmp_path
+    assert get_report_root(tmp_path, [descendant, tmp_path]) == tmp_path
+
+
+def test_siblings(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    first = tmp_path / "first"
+    second = tmp_path / "second"
+    first.mkdir()
+    second.mkdir()
+
+    assert get_report_root(tmp_path, [first, second]) == tmp_path
+
+
+def test_file_result_ignores_missing_paths(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    test_file = tmp_path / "tests" / "test_example.py"
+    test_file.parent.mkdir()
+    test_file.touch()
+
+    assert (
+        get_report_root(tmp_path, [tmp_path / "missing", test_file]) == test_file.parent
+    )
+
+
+def test_paths_without_a_shared_ancestor(
+    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
+    first = Path("first")
+    second = tmp_path / "second"
+    first.mkdir()
+    second.mkdir()
+
+    assert get_report_root(tmp_path, [first, second]) == first
